queries: WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS invoice_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) AS avg_invoice_ratio FROM invoice_averages) SELECT AVG(i.avg_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost, AVG(i.invoice_ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(i.invoice_ratio - o.avg_invoice_ratio) AS avg_ratio_excess FROM invoice_averages i CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE i.invoice_ratio > o.avg_invoice_ratio
